headline: Milki Delivery launches November 17 on Steam
title: Milki Delivery | Cosy Milk Route Launches Nov 17 | Gaming News
video_script: Milki Delivery, a cosy countryside delivery game, launches on Steam on November seventeenth, twenty twenty six. You play Neha, who runs a milk delivery service with her cow Milki, bringing bottles to the neighbours of a quiet village. It is published by Wholesome Games Presents and comes from the developers Blibloop and Doot. A free demo is already on Steam. Would you deliver the milk? Comment below!
description: Milki Delivery launches on Steam on November 17, 2026 (some regions see November 18 due to time zones). Published by Wholesome Games Presents. Sources: Steam store page, GamePressure, Automaton.
joke: I hope the cow gets a tip too.
